non_negotiable.description: The primary entry point for all departing passengers, housing main transport links and entrance portals.
Dedicated zones for document verification and boarding pass issuance, featuring specialized lanes for Platinum and Staff members.
Automated kiosks for tagging and injecting luggage into the sorting system, including a dedicated belt for oversized items.
Payment counter for luggage exceeding standard weight or piece limits.
Centralized information hub for passenger inquiries, wayfinding, and airport assistance.

amenities.description: Premium vehicle drop-off service located directly at the Terminal 1 Departure curb.
Hub for international car rental brands including Hertz, Avis, and Sixt.
On-site security office for reporting lost items or legal documentation issues.
Validation point for VAT refunds on goods purchased by international tourists.
Administrative and ticketing offices for Air Blue, Air China, and partner carriers.

the_boundary.description: Mandatory TSA-standard security checkpoint for carry-on screening and body scans.
Immigration zone featuring biometric Smart Gates for rapid exit clearance.

non_negotiable.description: Primary transit paths and automated people movers connecting the central hub to boarding zones.
Specialized checkpoint for transit passengers moving between international flights.
Final holding area for passengers prior to aircraft entry.
The physical jet bridge connecting the terminal gate to the aircraft door.

amenities.description: Large retail space offering tax-free cosmetics, spirits, and luxury confections.
High-end lounge featuring buffet dining, showers, and quiet work pods.
Compact soundproof cabins for short-term rest between long-haul flights.
Quick-service massage and nail treatments for travelers on the go.
Gaming lounge equipped with high-spec PCs and latest consoles.
Global coffeehouse chain offering beverages and light snacks.
Authentic French sit-down restaurant overlooking the runway.
